description:
Recent liquidation events (side, price, qty), NEWEST FIRST, at most `limit` rows (max
    2000). Market-wide, 500 rows is only a few minutes of a busy hour: pass `symbol` (BTCUSDT)
    and/or `min_usd` to look further back, or use get_liquidations_summary for totals and
    get_history for the archive. side=long means a long position was liquidated.
name: get_liquidations
